repos.name: agent-desktop
repos.description: Computer use CLI for AI agents
repos.description_zh: 面向 AI 智能体的计算机操作（Computer Use）命令行工具。

repos.name: claude-mem
repos.description: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent – Captures everything your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, OpenCode + More
repos.description_zh: 为所有智能体提供跨会话的持久化上下文——记录智能体在会话中产生的全部操作，用 AI 压缩后，将相关上下文注入未来的会话。兼容 Claude Code、OpenClaw、Codex、Gemini、Hermes、Copilot、OpenCode 等。

repos.name: Scrapling
repos.description: 🕷️ The BEST Web Scraping framework that handles everything from a single request to a full-scale crawl! Don't be shy, join here: https://discord.gg/EMgGbDceNQ and follow here for daily tips and tricks: https://x.com/Scrapling_dev
repos.description_zh: 🕷️ 最强大的网页抓取框架，从单次请求到大规模爬虫无所不包！

repos.name: Hyprland
repos.description: Hyprland is an independent, highly customizable, dynamic tiling Wayland compositor that doesn't sacrifice on its looks.
repos.description_zh: Hyprland 是一个独立、高度可定制、动态的平铺式 Wayland 合成器，且不牺牲视觉美观。

repos.name: Claude-Code-Game-Studios
repos.description: Turn Claude Code into a full game dev studio — 49 AI agents, 72 workflow skills, and a complete coordination system mirroring real studio hierarchy.

repos.description_zh: FreeToken 将数据中心级别的模型服务带到你的桌面：在本地快速、高效地运行超大规模模型。

repos.name: Kronos

repos.description_zh: Kronos：读懂金融市场「语言」的基础模型。

repos.description: 🐍 Geometric Computer Vision Library for Spatial AI
repos.description_zh: 🐍 面向空间智能（Spatial AI）的几何计算机视觉库。
